neighbours.label: ' A' or ' a' as the split first letter of an uncommon name or word (A|mon, A|hab, A|vid, a|vertis), not the English article
fire: The temple at Thebes honored the god Amon above all others.
Captain Ahab chased the white whale around the world.
Most film editors in Hollywood cut on Avid machines.
Pour être avertis par courriel, inscrivez-vous sur le site.
Priests of Amon held great power in ancient Egypt.
Melville based Ahab partly on a real whaling captain.
The studio bought ten new Avid systems for its editors.
Nous voulons être avertis de la date de la réunion.
quiet: The temple at Thebes honored the god Horus above all others.
Captain Nemo chased the giant squid around the world.
Most film editors in Hollywood cut on Apple machines.
Pour être informés par courriel, inscrivez-vous sur le site.
Priests of Horus held great power in ancient Egypt.
Melville based Billy partly on a real young sailor.
The studio bought ten new Sony systems for its editors.

short: split first letter ' A'/' a' of a name or word
notes: Card: ' A' x14, ' a' x8, ''a', 'A', 'a', 'M', mostly before a split name or word at L34, a next-piece position. Probes: Amon 0.962, avertis 0.388, aif-style ' a' in a format list 0.339, ' A' in Avid 0.123, 'A / V' 0.135; Sony 0.007. Tokens are checked. Near misses use whole-token names.
